stem: At shift change, there is an unresolved wet-floor hazard near equipment, an identity mismatch, and a routine pruning task still incomplete. What should be emphasized first in the handoff?
choices: The unresolved safety hazard and identity-control issue before routine unfinished production work
The pruning task because it is on the schedule
rationale: Handoff should prioritize safety-critical and control-critical open conditions so the incoming shift can manage immediate risk before routine production work.
